title: MODIS coastal versus offshore chlorophyll
query: Using monthly MODIS-Aqua chlorophyll for 2003–2012, compare the SEATS-area box 115.5–116.5 E, 17.5–18.5 N with the Pearl River coastal box 112–115 E, 21–23 N. Calculate regional time series and seasonal climatologies, identify supported contrasts and anomalies, and assess how valid-pixel coverage affects interpretation. Only the supplied chlorophyll product is required; do not attempt a three-algorithm or in-situ validation. Use only the supplied public data and coordinate-defined masks; no private profiles, author simulations or additional measurements are required. Report methods, executed numerical evidence, a concise interpretation and an editable analysis.ipynb. The reference paper motivates the diagnostic, but its observational values are not target answers for this adapted input.
adaptation: Public-data method transfer with reduced scope, authorized 2026-09-08; not exact reproduction of the original observational archive.
